### Filtering Variants

There are several ways to spot potential false positives through filtering.
_Hard filtering_ uses pre-defined thresholds of different variant annotations (allele-depth, mapping quality and many others) in order to flag variants passing all these criteria, and those failing to meet any of them.
This approach is mostly useful when calling a few samples and enough data are not available for more sophisticated solutions.
